# Kipngetich Generally

> Official website of Kipngetich Generally, whose full name is Gilbert Kipngetich Langat.

Canonical website: https://generallykip.github.io/

## Identity
Kipngetich Generally is the public identity used on this website. Gilbert Kipngetich Langat is the full name associated with that identity.

## Professional focus
ICT | Innovation | Digital Transformation | Technology for Development

Areas of interest include information technology, ICT support, innovation, digital transformation, data management, community development, leadership, and public service.

## Education
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Karatina University (graduated 2024).

## Background
Born in Morombo Village, Embomos Ward, Konoin Constituency, Bomet County, Kenya. Attended Chebugen Primary School, Kimugul Primary School, and Cheborgei Boys High School.

## Experience and community engagement
- Community engagement with Dandelion Africa on awareness and efforts to prevent female genital mutilation (FGM).
- General Worker at Kobel Tea Factory.
- ICT Support attachment at the County Government of Bomet.
- Polling Clerk with the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) in 2022.
